FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave, derived from OpenSubtitles 2018 (OPUS).
Source commit: 525f9b560de45753a5ea01069454e72e9aa541c6
https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords
Adaptation by CoolBoard: lower-case vocabulary filtered to each supported layout; up to 6000 words per language, merged with local starter words.
